dataList.content:
... Understood, Mistress. I shall do as you command.
……是，好的。夫人。按您的吩咐。
dataList.place:
Wuthering Heights Corridors
呼啸山庄 走廊

dataList.content:
We will not waste any more time here. Let's go and clear out the Dead Rabbits rabble.
我们不要在这里继续浪费时间，去把死兔帮的那些人清理掉。

... We'll put the rest of you in the bin should our paths cross again.
……下次再见面的话就连你们也一起收拾了。

Tsk...
嘁……

Hindley didn't show even a hint of gratitude.
在亨德利的身上感受不到丝毫感激之情。

Well… I could’ve handled them all on my own. I didn't need your help to beat up some insane old hag and her pawns…
呵……就算我一个人也可以做那些人的对手。区区精神错乱的约瑟芬和她的跟班们……

<... Maybe we should’ve just left him behind.>
<……就该装作没看见。>

And that ‘Boss’ of yours… you don't even remember his name properly, do you? So much for your loyalty.
而且，那个被你称作大哥的家伙……你连他的名字都记错了，还跟人虚情假意。

Rage slowly returns to Heathcliff's face and draws a deep crease between his brows.
希斯克利夫暂时平静下来的眉头又深深皱了起来。

… What dodgy nonsense are you blathering about?
……你在狗扯什么？

He goes by 'Matt'. Not Matthew, or whatever you decided to call him.
那家伙叫马特。不是马修。

What? What are you... have you finally gone mad? I've known the gaffer for years, and you think I'd get his name wrong?
啥？什么……你疯了吗？我会把自己处了好几年的大哥名字弄错吗？

Besides...
而且……

That insane old hag still has some of her wits about. Because I do intend to take this manor back. No matter what.
那精神失常的约瑟芬眼力倒是不错！她知道我打算不择手段地夺回这座宅邸。

I almost had it! If only I hadn't gotten that confounded card in that round...!
咳……那一局明明都快赢了……但凡没有出现那张牌……

No, the game must've been rigged. That’s the only way this makes sense. Nothing else explains how Catherine could have had the funds so ready to purchase Wuthering Heights the moment it was put up for sale at the auction.
不对，那一局一定被人做了手脚。定然是这样。若非如此，凯瑟琳怎么可能直接就把转到拍卖会上的呼啸山庄买下来。

You lost this manor in a gamble? And Catherine bought it back?
你是说凯瑟琳重新买下了这座被你输掉的宅邸？

Yes! That girl was always as insane as Josephine.
没错！她也和约瑟芬一样是个精神失常的人。

But mark my words, Wuthering Heights shall be mine again.
但呼啸山庄马上就会回到我手上。

Matt's made a deal with me.
马特和我签了合同。

He promised to help me retrieve this manor, as long as I let him and his Dead Rabbits into Wuthering Heights.
只要把他和死兔帮一起带进呼啸山庄……他就答应把这座宅邸还给我。

Master Hindley, wait. Where are you going?
等下，您这是要去哪里，亨德利大人？

You didn't seriously expect me to be cosy with you lot after that, did you?
你不会以为我要跟你们和睦地同行吧？

I'll find Matt. And I'll do everything I can to make this place mine again.
马特，我得再见他一次，动用我能做的一切手段。

... And don't be so quick to assume that you've really changed, Heathcliff.
而且……你可别自以为是地认为自己成为了与过去不同的人，希斯克利夫。

You haven't. You simply can't change.
你没有改变。而且也无法改变。

You're nothing but a ragged sack of waste. Don't you forget that.
只配得上套着破布袋子的家伙。你给我记好了。

What an asshole...
这脾气真是……

Ahem, Sir Heathcliff... I am quite unsure as to how much of my words may reach thine ears, given thy fury, but...
呃哼，希斯克利夫先生……虽不知这番话语能否对火冒三丈的汝有所帮助……

Hah.
哈。

Some Sinners attempted to cheer Heathcliff up, who would normally be seething with anger upon hearing abuse like that, but...
看着平时看起来总像是在生着气的希斯克利夫的脸色，某些罪人打算说上几句话。

... this was different. It wasn't anger.
但希斯克利夫好像有别的想法。

Back then... whenever I heard that kind of contemptuous shite from that bastard...
以前……当我看到那个每天都急着要践踏我的家伙……

... it felt as though every word he spat out rang true. That I really was just a useless lowlife who deserved nothing but the rags.
都感到仿佛我真的如他所说一般，变成了最没用的底层人。

I've spent days and nights coming up with all kinds of ways I'd exact my revenge on 'im. But now it's...
我每天都思考着报复那家伙的方法。但现在……

Hah, bloody hell. I can't even put this feeling to words.
哈，真是。现在这心情是怎么回事……真让人搞不懂……

He's the one that couldn't change, not you. Look at him, clinging desperately to his past like it's the only thing he's got.
没有改变的是那家伙。他只能被阴暗地困在过去。

He's just... he's just like an immature kid who never grew up past ten.
就像……还是那未曾长大的十岁小孩一般。

Where is Catherine's room? We would do well to be on our guard in this manor. We must always be wary of our surroundings in this field of battle.
凯瑟琳的房间大概在哪里？随意穿梭于交战中的宅邸是不大可能了。

It should be there once we turn right here. Odd... I don't recall the corridor being this long.
在这里右转应该就可以了。真奇怪，这走廊原来有这么长吗……

Heavens! There...
天哪！那里……

Dead Rabbits. At the end of the corridor.
走廊的尽头。有死兔帮的人。

Is it just me, or do they look a bit different from earlier? I'll take "it's just you" for an answer, by the way.
看起来和刚刚好像不太一样，有没有人能来解释一下，是不是我的心情在作祟？

That reminds me... I have heard tales from the streets about those strange, wandering Dead Rabbits.
这么说来……我在街上听说过和那样游荡着的死兔帮有关的传闻……

Word on the street is that we should steer clear of the Dead Rabbits with red eyes... Just... like... the ones they have...
在多种意味上……避免与那种……红色的眼睛接触……会比较好……

死兔帮
dataList.teller:
Strange Dead Rabbits Henchman
诡异的死兔帮成员

dataList.content:
Excuse me, are you looking for something... or someone?
你们……在找什么……还是说在找谁？

Just for your information, that 'Linton' fella ain't here! Those 'Butlers' of Wuthering Heights ain't here either. They all went that way, past the hallway. Clearly, you've got no beef with us, right? Ha ha ha.
作为参考！我们之中没有叫林顿的人。呼啸山庄的管家……那家伙刚才也走向了那边的走廊。所以我们之间应该没什么瓜葛对吧？哈哈。

听得到我们讲话吗？如果你有什么想要的就明确回应。如果有交涉的余地……

What a shame. I, Outis, would have loved to demonstrate my excellent negotiation skills to the Executive Manager.
令人惋惜。每次向执行经理展示我奥提斯谈判技巧的机会都这样化为泡影了。
